About Talkyd

A trusted industrial and chemical supply company powering industries across Africa since 2018.

Who We Are

Your Strategic Industrial Supply Partner in Africa

Talkyd Industrials is a professional industrial and chemical supply company headquartered in Kampala, Uganda. We specialize in the wholesale distribution of industrial chemicals, raw materials, laboratory supplies, and specialty products to businesses across Africa.

Founded in 2018, we operate as a non-manufacturing distributor — serving as the critical link between world-class global manufacturers and the industries, institutions, and businesses that depend on reliable chemical inputs to operate and grow.

Our Mission

To deliver reliable, high-quality industrial and chemical supply solutions that empower African industries to operate efficiently, safely, and competitively.

  • Source quality products from verified global manufacturers
  • Ensure safe, compliant handling and delivery
  • Provide technical expertise and responsive support

Our Vision

To become the most trusted and comprehensive industrial supply partner across Africa — recognized for reliability, quality, and our commitment to African industrial growth.

  • Pan-African distribution network
  • World-class supply chain standards
  • Long-term partnerships built on trust
What We Do

Our Core Services

We provide end-to-end industrial supply solutions — from sourcing to delivery — across multiple sectors and industries.

Industrial Chemicals Supply

We source and distribute a comprehensive range of industrial-grade chemicals for manufacturing, processing, and production operations across Africa.

Raw Materials Distribution

Reliable supply of polymers, resins, solvents, and specialty raw materials to support diverse industrial applications.

Procurement & Logistics

End-to-end procurement management and pan-African logistics, ensuring products reach clients safely and on schedule.

Multi-Industry Support

Tailored supply solutions for manufacturing, agriculture, water treatment, construction, laboratories, and more.

Our Journey

Growing Since 2018

From a focused startup to a multi-sector industrial supply partner — here is how we have grown.

2018

Founded

Talkyd Industrials was established in Kampala, Uganda, with a clear mission: to bridge the gap between global chemical manufacturers and African industries.

2019–2020

Building Partnerships

Secured strategic partnerships with international manufacturers, expanding our product portfolio to cover industrial chemicals, laboratory reagents, and raw materials.

2021–2022

Multi-Sector Expansion

Extended our reach into agriculture, water treatment, construction, and pharmaceutical sectors — becoming a true multi-industry supply partner.

2023–Present

Pan-African Growth

Strengthened our distribution network across East Africa, deepened client relationships, and committed to delivering world-class supply chain standards.
